description: List every label in the mailbox, system and user-created, with each label's ID, name and type. Use this to find the label ID that gmail_label_message, gmail_update_label and gmail_delete_label need.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_list_labels
